## Native Rust Unslop

- Replaced the Python implementation with a Rust executable under `tools/unslop/`. Prek builds it with Cargo and runs independent Markdown batches in parallel.
- Kept all 25 rules, recommended and strict presets, configuration overrides, suppression directives, Unicode source locations, and text, JSON, and GitHub output.
- On the same 3,655-file snapshot, the Rust CLI took 0.60 seconds versus 7.37 seconds for Python, with all 691 diagnostics matching. The Rust hook took 0.17 seconds through Prek in the consuming repository.
- CI builds Rust, checks formatting and Clippy, compares 59 CLI reference cases, exercises configuration errors and output formats, and checks a 20,000-line code block. The hook and copied-configuration suites install the native Rust executable.
- Release preparation updates Cargo metadata and the copyable configuration together.
